_: INVENTED, PHOTO-SOURCED CONTENT — epoch 2024-2025. NEVER A SOURCE FOR ANY MEASURED CONSUMER. Every entity in this document is modelled from published architectural photography and a 2021 design site plan, not from OSM, not from LiDAR, and not from the ArcGIS survey. Positions are INFERRED: each item names the surveyed polygon it was anchored to (`anchor`), and that anchor is the only measured fact behind it. Nothing here may be read back as a measurement of the campus, quoted as a height, a colour or a position by campus-eighth.js, campus-eighth-furniture.js, the corridor builders, or any gate. It renders and it is labelled; it does not inform. Class rule: docs/js/campus-photo-eighth.js header, and the README's photo-sourced section.

bbq.note: Position inferred from photo geometry. The inventory could not resolve the grill station in the repo frame; it is placed on the north-east edge of the surveyed paved courtyard directly north of Pulse Tower, facing north across the (unsurveyed) lawn, which is the arrangement crop_grill.png shows — grills in front of a paved picnic terrace with a tower behind the camera-facing enclosure. `rotY` aligns every piece with that courtyard's own measured north-east edge (-121.2,524.9)-(-144.3,533.6).

amphitheatre.anchor: band between arcgis.ground#3898 (basketball-court) east edge and arcgis.ground#2144
amphitheatre.note: Position inferred from the 2021 site plan's zigzag tiered edge between court J and lawn A. Only the BAND is anchored — the court's surveyed east edge at x -163.2 and the surveyed planting bed at x -158.9 bracket it. Tier count, length and riser are estimated. Kept 0.9 m clear of the painted court.

meditation.anchor: open paved spine between arcgis.ground#328 and arcgis.ground#329
meditation.note: Location confirmed twice (Eighth's own page: 'between the Pulse and Azad buildings'; the site plan's B label). The photo-to-label assignment of EYRC phf47 is likely-but-unconfirmed. SCALE IS REDUCED FROM THE PHOTO ESTIMATE ON PURPOSE: phf47 reads a 26-30 m roof, but the surveyed open spine between the two courtyard rings is only ~11 x 8 m, and the two planted rings are measured. The composition is fitted to the surveyed opening rather than overrunning it.

teaHouse.note: The plan scales the TEA HOUSE label to about (-145, 592), which lands in the unsurveyed gap between two planting beds. Moved ~6 m south-east onto the nearest surveyed Ramble polygon, per the inventory's own instruction to tie it to a real polygon before shipping. Form, batten module and setting are from z_teahouse.png.

ramble.note: SWA's restored drainage corridor. Every position here is inferred: each field, patch and cluster is placed inside a surveyed planting bed or courtyard, and the extents are fitted to that polygon rather than to the photograph. The scatter inside each is deterministic from `seed`, never Math.random. Species schedule is unsourced — the grasses are generic bunch-grass cones, not an identified plant.

furniture.note: Site furniture positions are inferred. Each run is placed on a surveyed walkway or courtyard and kept clear of the plaza objects campus-eighth-furniture.js measures.

absent: Basketball hoop, backboard, court fencing and court-side seating — no legible photo in the reference set. Left unbuilt.
A third grill bay — exactly two are photographed. The inventory says do not model a third.
Survivance Hall — 11 storeys and a southern position are documented, its facade is not, and it is missing from the repo dossier too. Massing is not this module's job in any case.
Podemos low-rise and the dining pavilion — no source.
Meditation pavilion and tea house interiors beyond the bench — no source.
Plant species — the grasses are generic bunch-grass cones, deliberately not an identified species.
The public-art mural, the balcony stack, the facade window reveals and every other facade feature — facade work belongs to the measured massing pass, not to an invented overlay.
The lawn panel itself — the big turf panel north of the terrace is not in the ArcGIS survey, so its outline is unknown. Better absent than a guessed polygon.
Young multi-trunk staked trees — campus-trees.js owns trees from a measured source; adding invented ones here would put two tree populations on one ground.

revelle.label: Revelle College — photo-sourced detail
revelle.note: INVENTED, photo-sourced class. Modelled from dated photographs of Revelle College listed in `sources`; positions are anchored to the MEASURED plaza polygon and building rings in campus-3d.json, and every solid item here was checked at least 3 m clear of the corridor-staging centreline when this file was generated.
